comment: Which local log sources are shipped to the dashboard (fnmatch on source name; deny wins). The catalog is shipped too and shown in the (i) tooltip on /logs.

tracked.what: System package installs, upgrades and config changes
Box services: host, supervisor, desktop sessions, telemetry, cookie and session sync
Command execution daemon that runs agent shell commands
Desktop browser, VNC, window manager, dock and compositor output
Ad-hoc job output from agents: builds, test runs, git pushes
Any file a running process writes its output to, found via /proc/<pid>/fd
Kernel ring buffer: boot, devices, OOM kills, segfaults
systemd journal via journalctl (currently has no journal files on this box)
Once a minute: bytes in/out per interface from /proc/net/dev and socket counts plus top 5 peers from ss. No packet capture
Grok Bot routine runs and the routine registry

excluded.what: Shell histories, .env, *.token, *.pem/*.key, secret and credential files

excluded.why: Full conversation content, may include secrets and personal data
Binary site-storage databases with session data, not logs

excluded.what: wtmp, btmp, lastlog and other binary files
node_modules, git internals, plugin test fixtures

unavailable.why: Not readable as a stream here; dmesg is used instead

unavailable.what: stdout/stderr of root or other-user processes

unavailable.why: Needs root, and too heavy; per-minute summaries instead

catalog.notes: Every line is redacted twice (on the box when collected, again before shipping). Consecutive repeated lines are collapsed. Kept 7 days, max 200k lines on the server.
